description.zh: 目标实例中迁移对象所属的rds实例id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有rds实例的详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance to which the migration object belongs in the target instance. > You can invoke the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all ApsaraDB RDS instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 目标rds实例高权限账号的密码。>*长度为8~32个字符。*由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。*特殊字符为!@#$&%^*()_+-=
description.en: The password of the privileged account for the destination ApsaraDB RDS instance. > * The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length. * The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. * Special characters include ! @ # $ & % ^ * ( ) _ + - =.

description.zh: 目标实例的连接用户名
description.en: The username used to connect to the target instance.

description.zh: 地域id。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
description.en: The region ID. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

description.zh: 源rds实例的用户密码。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括用户密码。
description.en: The password of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including the password.

description.zh: 源实例（源数据库）的连接用户名
description.en: The username used to connect to the source instance (source database).

descriptions.zh: 数据同步阶段，主动发起对复制链路的诊断任务，检查是否存在延迟、中断、数据不一致等异常问题
descriptions.en: During the data synchronization phase, proactively initiates a diagnostic task for the replication task to check for issues such as latency, replication interruption, or data inconsistency.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx create-rpl-inspection-task --slink-task-id etx-szr2rr6i00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --src-user-name bbt_ump --src-password 000000 --dst-res-id pxc-zkrc10000l54rc --dst-db transfer_test3 --dst-user-name bbt_item --dst-password 000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx CreateRplInspectionTask --region cn-hangzhou --DstPassword 000000 --DstResId 'pxc-zkrc10000l54rc' --DstDb transfer_test3 --SrcPassword 000000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SrcUserName bbt_ump --SlinkTaskId 'etx-szr2rr6i00000' --DstUserName bbt_item
